children: AbbVie completed the $10.9 billion acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics and reaffirms its 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance.
Acquired all Apogee shares for $135.11 per share in cash, valuing the deal at ~ $10.9 billion; Apogee delisted Sept. 3, 2026.
Acquisition expected to dilute adjusted diluted EPS by $0.14 in 2026 (partial year) and ~ $0.46 in 2027; accretion begins in 2032.
Adds zumilokibart (late-stage IL-13 antibody) and APG273 (IL-13 + TSLP combo) to AbbVie’s immunology pipeline with potential long-acting dosing.
Reaffirms 2026 full-year adjusted diluted EPS guidance of $13.87–$14.07 and Q3 guidance of $3.84–$3.88.
